workLog.action: verified what the gate actually prints instead of trusting either version
workLog.evidence: scripts/quality_gate/external_signal_gate.py line 110 builds aggregator_argv as ['--json'], so gate_aggregator.main always takes the JSON branch at line 155 and prints json.dumps(payload, indent=2). The payload keys are verdict, reason, and signals.

workLog.action: established that the merged snippet cannot be found by grep
workLog.evidence: GOTCHAS.md quoted 'verdict: NEEDS_REVIEW   reason: closed-loop:external-signal-inconclusive' as one lowercase prose line. Real output is indented, quoted JSON keys on separate lines. A reader searching CI logs for the documented string finds nothing, which defeats the entry.

workLog.action: quoted the two lines a reader will actually search for
workLog.evidence: Replaced the prose line with the verbatim JSON key lines in a text fence, and said in the lead-in that the gate prints JSON so the reader greps quoted keys. A text fence avoids claiming a truncated object parses as JSON, which the abandoned reformat did.

workLog.action: started from origin/main rather than salvaging the stale branch
workLog.evidence: git switch -c docs/gotchas-spec-gate-snippet origin/main. Rebasing a branch whose commits were already merged risks conflicts and replays content that is on main, so a fresh branch keeps the diff to the one hunk that is genuinely new.

workLog.action: Cross-family adversarial review on gpt-5.6-terra returned 2 High, 2 Medium, 1 Low against the first draft of the ratchet section. Verified every finding against source and adopted all five.
workLog.outcome: High: the ratchets sit in the same parallel:true group as python-tests, so the 'runs after the suite' ordering claim was false; reworded to the wait, with the measured 946s vs 2.6s split. High: the quoted failure text mixed baseline and measured count into one placeholder, a combination the code cannot emit; replaced with real output generated by calling _above_base_message directly. Medium: gate_aggregator has a reachable prose path when run by hand, so the JSON claim is now scoped to the spec wrapper. Medium: amending is safe whenever the recorded SHA stays an ancestor, not only at HEAD~1. Low: ruff_count_ratchet needs --extra dev to match the hook
